title: Chart quiz #20
caption:
Chart quiz #20. Three charts, three calls.

Q1: Gap fill, or gap and go?
Q2: Which trade plan is better?
Q3: Which line is real support?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Earnings #RiskReward #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Gaps, plans and support. Question one. Earnings came out, and the stock gapped up. Will the gap fill, or will it gap and go? It filled. Volume faded after the open, and long upper wicks showed sellers waiting above. Gaps on strong, rising volume are more likely to keep going. Question two. Same entry, two plans. Green is the target, red is the stop. Is plan A better, or plan B? Plan B. Plan A risks as much as it can make. Plan B risks a little to make several times more. You can be wrong more often, and still come out ahead. Question three. Price is falling again, with three lines drawn underneath. Which one is real support? A, B, or C? B. Buyers stepped in at that level three times before, so traders are watching it. A and C are just lines on a chart. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
